category_edits.rationale: Anchor positions to recency across all four category models: the rightmost nonpadding token receives position 1 and padding remains 0. The generated predictor imports this same model class, keeping masked training and appended-mask inference consistent without changing checkpoint shapes.

response.change_summary: Replace chronological position IDs with reverse nonpadding ranks. Preserve masked-target training, appended-mask readout, model topology, scoring, loss, optimizer, and category routing.
